fluff.overview: ComStar organized its military forces around a combined-arms doctrine that valued infantry as an essential element of the Level I through Level VI command structure, with conventional platoons serving alongside BattleMechs, armor, and aerospace assets at every echelon. Jump-capable platoons provide vertical mobility for urban operations and rough terrain that would slow or halt conventional foot infantry. ComStar deployed jump platoons in specialized roles where their ability to bypass obstacles justified the additional cost of jump equipment and training. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
